/** Untracked files whose names look like secrets: never read, never sent. */
const SECRET_NAME = /(?:^|\/)\.env[^/]*$|\.(?:pem|key)$|secret|credential/iu;

/**
 * Whether an untracked file may be read and sent to the reviewers.
 * @param path the file, relative to the repository
 * @returns false for names that look like secrets
 */
export const isSentUntracked = (path: string): boolean =>
  !SECRET_NAME.test(path);

/**
 * An untracked file as a diff section, so reviewers see it as new.
 * @param path the file, relative to the repository
 * @param content its text
 * @returns the section
 */
export const untrackedSection = (path: string, content: string): string =>
  [
    `diff --git a/${path} b/${path}`,
    "new file (untracked)",
    "--- /dev/null",
    `+++ b/${path}`,
    ...content
      .replace(/\n$/u, "")
      .split("\n")
      .map((line) => `+${line}`),
    "",
  ].join("\n");

/**
 * Cuts the diff at the cap, saying so at the cut.
 * @param diff the whole diff
 * @param cap the most characters kept
 * @returns the diff, or its head and a note
 */
export const capDiff = (diff: string, cap: number): string =>
  diff.length > cap
    ? `${diff.slice(0, cap)}\n[council: diff cut at ${String(cap)} bytes of ${String(diff.length)}]\n`
    : diff;

{
  "name": "agent-council",
  "version": "0.3.3",
  "description": "A council of independent code reviewers (Codex, Pi, Devin, OpenCodeReview) runs over your working diff in parallel; one summary of agreements, disagreements and unique findings. /council, plus an auto-review that only notifies.",
  "author": {
    "name": "apolenkov"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/apolenkov/agent-council",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "agent-council",
    "code-review",
    "council",
    "codex",
    "pi",
    "devin",
    "ocr",
    "jev"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "members": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Members",
      "description": "Comma list of reviewers to use, in order (codex, pi, devin, ocr). Empty: every installed one.",
      "required": false,
      "default": ""
    },
    "limitsDir": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Limits folder",
      "description": "Folder of per-member files holding the epoch (seconds) a usage limit resets; a member with a future epoch is skipped. Read only; missing files are ignored.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "~/.local/state/executor-limits"
    },
    "timeoutMin": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Member timeout (minutes)",
      "description": "How long one reviewer may run before it is stopped.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 8
    },
    "summarizer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Summarizer",
      "description": "\"claude\" (default): the session's Claude merges the findings. \"jev\": TypeSafe Jev scores duplicates, noise and contradictions (needs TYPESAFE_API_KEY), Claude writes the prose.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "claude",
      "options": [
        "claude",
        "jev"
      ]
    },
    "summarizerModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Summary model",
      "description": "The Claude model that writes the summary: an alias (sonnet, opus, haiku) or a full model id.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "typesafeApiKey": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeSafe API key",
      "description": "For the jev summarizer on a remote System One URL; kept in secure storage. Empty: the TYPESAFE_API_KEY environment variable. A loopback URL needs none.",
      "required": false,
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "systemOneUrl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "System One URL",
      "description": "Base URL of the System One API the jev summarizer asks: TypeSafe by default, or a local server such as Kev (http://127.0.0.1:8010), which needs no key. Plain http is accepted only for 127.0.0.1, localhost and ::1.",
      "required": false,
      "default": "https://api.typesafe.ai"
    },
    "systemOneModel": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "System One model",
      "description": "The model System One runs (kev-latest for a local Kev). Empty: TYPESAFE_MODEL, else jev-latest.",
      "required": false,
      "default": ""
    },
    "jevThreshold": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Jev noise threshold",
      "description": "Findings Jev rates below this probability of being a real defect move to notes (0 to 1).",
      "required": false,
      "default": 0.3
    },
    "autoReview": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Auto-review",
      "description": "\"off\" (default): only /council runs the council. \"notify\": once the session is idle after an answered turn with a changed diff, the council runs and only notifies you (the members' CLIs may cost you money).",
      "required": false,
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "notify",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "cooldownMin": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Auto-review cooldown (minutes)",
      "description": "The least time between two auto-reviews.",
      "required": false,
      "default": 10
    }
  }
}
